title: MySQL and MariaDB
description: A MySQL or MariaDB database — also Amazon RDS and Aurora MySQL, Google Cloud SQL, Azure Database for MySQL, PlanetScale.

fields.name: ssl
fields.label: SSL
fields.help: require (the default) for anything on a network.

setup.title: Where the database is
setup.say:
The address MySQL answers on, as the engine reaches it — a name like db.example.com, or an IP address. Not "localhost", unless the engine runs on that same machine.

If the database lets in only known addresses (a firewall, an allow-list, a cloud security group), let the engine's machine in first.

setup.title: A user that may read
setup.say: Superatom only reads. Give it a user of its own that may read and nothing more — run this as an admin (choose a password, and name your database):

copy.label: Make a read-only user
copy.value:
CREATE USER 'superatom'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'choose-a-password';
GRANT SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON your_database.* TO 'superatom'@'%';

fix.when: is not allowed to connect|Host '.*' is not allowed
fix.say: MySQL does not let the user in from the engine's address. Make the user for '%' (any address) or for the engine's address.
